rules: Monthly expenses are compiled and split on the last day of each month.
All members must clear their monthly mess payment before the 12th of every month.
Any member who wants to skip meals must inform the mess at least 2 days before.
If any member requires a special, additional, or new food item, they must inform the Chef at least 5 hours in advance to make the necessary arrangements for preparation.
Mess Period: 10th of the current month to 9th of the following month.
If a new person is joining, please let the mess management know in advance.
Dear all, if you would like to change the mess menu, please inform the group in advance so everyone can share their opinion. Any menu changes should be announced in the mess WhatsApp group.
